additional_info.body:
Dear
Chloë
,
Following your report and after our checks, we can see that the problem is related to DC1 ErrorCode: 33, which is caused by ELMS being configured but inactive. We have already reconfigured the ELMS, and now the charger is working normally.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
